projects.title: Derivatives & Hedging Model Risk
projects.interpretation: Registered four-method comparison on nine historical BTC dates: 1,868 raw option rows, 27 eligible date/expiry groups, 195 held-out strikes. Raw SVI common-interior IV RMSE 1.84 pp vs SSVI 3.98 pp; raw SVI fails 23/27 stress-density checks. Original 466-row/six-expiry study and 27 hedge scenarios on 3,000 GBM paths preserved.
projects.limit: Dependent December 2018 convenience archive, amended pre-fit registration and reconstructed variance under zero-rate/index/recorded-underlying assumptions; mismatched underlying references retained. SSVI idealized sufficient conditions do not validate market forwards or unseen tails. Convex model refuses 13 boundary points. No forecast, validated venue IV, executable arbitrage or realized PnL; prior GBM hedging is simulation.
